scene.note: Theo's changes left lines Node cannot read, so the terminal shows an error until you fix each one and the report reaches Ines.

steps.note: Under Task 1, one line should print how many candles Ines poured, but Theo's change broke it.
Node reads the whole file before it runs anything, and stops at the first line it cannot read.
The terminal shows where Node stopped: the file, the line, the marks under it and the kind of error.
Once the line can be read, the candles poured are back in the report.
Under Task 2, the line for the orders waiting is the next one Node cannot read.
Node gets as far as that line and finds something it was waiting for is not there.
The kind of error says what Node expected, and the marks show where.
With the line whole again, Ines sees how many orders wait to be packed.
Under Task 3, the line for the parcels packed has every bracket it needs, and still Node stops.
The message is Node's guess at the cause. The marks show where the trouble really starts.
Fixed, the line prints the parcels packed so far.
Under Task 4, the line names the candle of the day, and its text has an apostrophe in it.
Node reads the text in quotes and decides it ends sooner than Theo meant.
The marks stop where Node thinks the text ended.
The report names today's candle, apostrophe and all, and Ines can start pouring.
